notes.title: Palworld studio changes its mind about releasing its co-op Hollow Knight-like in early access, will go straight to 1.0
notes.notes: Two years ago, Palworld answered the question, "What if Pokémon had base building and multiplayer?" Never Grave: The Witch and the Curse, Pocketpair's next game, developed by a new internal team, is giving the same treatment to Hollow Knight... Read more.

notes.title: Never Grave: The Witch and The Curse official release (v1.0) has been decided!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]･Official release version (v1.0) of Never Grave: The Witch and The Curse has been announced![/b][/h3][p]It has been decided that Never Grave, originally planned as an early access title, will instead launch directly as the official v1.0 release![/p][p][/p][p]Due to the valuable feedback from many players during the demo period, we have decided to deliver the game in its complete form, rather than in staged Early Access. The development team is currently making final adjustments to ensure that you receive the best gaming experience from day one. Stay tuned![/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]･Multi-platform release and crossplay![/b][/h3][p]In addition to the Steam version, we have decided to release the game for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, and Microsoft Store. In addition, it will support crossplay between all platforms, allowing multiplayer across all devices.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]・Please note, we will be closing the Steam demo soon.[/b][/h3][p]Thank you so much for playing the demo and sending in so much feedback and suggestions.[/p]

notes.title: Release Date Change
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We extend our sincere thanks to everyone who downloaded the "Never Grave" demo, shared feedback and added the game to their wishlists. 
The demo, released during the Feb 2024 Steam Next Fest, was installed by over 110,000 players and became one of the most played demos of the event. 
This significant milestone was achieved thanks to your unwavering support, and we're genuinely thrilled about it.

Today, we have an important update to share with you.

In response to your invaluable feedback, we've made the decision to adjust our release date in pursuit of delivering a higher quality experience.
Recognizing the unique blend of Metroidvania and Roguelite elements in Never Grave, we believe it's more beneficial to offer an Early Access version with a nearly finalized level of polish and content, rather than launching at an earlier stage of development. As a result, we've chosen to postpone the Early Access release until we can present a more refined and complete version.

In addition to our initial plans, we're committed to implementing various improvements based on your feedback. These enhancements include the introduction of new stages, fine-tuning animations, refining gameplay mechanics, and the incorporation of features such as:
Areas that make better use of enemy possession and the hat form.
A "treasure map" revealing hidden locations.
Enhanced liveliness and deeper story involvement of NPCs.

Our goal is to provide a game that truly delights you. We sincerely apologize for the delay to those eagerly anticipating our Early Access release and hope for your understanding of the reasons behind this decision. The new release date will be announced as soon as it is finalized.

We remain dedicated to delivering an exceptional gaming experience and appreciate your ongoing support.

Gratefully,

The Never Grave Dev Team

notes.title: Demo Version v0.1b.1416 Update
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
Thank you for playing the Never Grave demo.
We're pleased to announce some updates that have been made.

v0.1b.1416
- Tweaked the controller stick input dead zone for UI interactions.
- Improved the underwater audio effects by reducing the excessive emphasis on low-frequency sounds.
- Fixed a bug in the Demise Shop where a grimoire named "LocNoData" would appear.
- Slightly sped up the action of throwing tools.
- Addressed various minor bugs.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing the Never Grave demo. Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Demo Version v0.1b.0519 Update
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
Thank you for playing the Never Grave demo.
We're pleased to announce some updates that have been made.


v0.1b.0519
- Significantly improved rendering performance. As a side effect, audio distortion issues should also see improvement.
- Adjusted the player's and possessed dog's moving attacks to prevent them from passing through enemies, reducing the chance of receiving undue contact damage.
- Allowed the possessed dog to pass through one-block passages.
- Fixed a bug where the button input icons were not displayed correctly when the language setting was set to "English."
- Adjusted the players's normal combo attack so that damage increases with each strike. Specifically, decreased the attack power of the first strike, increased the power of the second strike, and significantly increased the power of the third strike.
- Fixed an issue with the axe monster's attack detection and super armor detection having too long durations.
- Addressed several minor bugs.
- Made some minor balance adjustments.

We hope you continue to enjoy playing the Never Grave demo. Thanks for your support.

notes.title: Announcement Regarding Release Date and Demo
notes.notes:
Hello everyone. 

We have a message from the development team behind Never Grave: The Witch and The Curse. 
We apologize to everyone who was looking forward to the release. We have decided to move the release date from winter 2023 to the first quarter of 2024. 
We appreciate your patience as we continue to work on the game and provide a better experience for you all. 

However, we do have some good news! Never Grave will be participating in the upcoming Steam Next Fest! During this event, we plan to offer a trial version where you can play the early stages of the game for about an hour. Please take this opportunity to fully enjoy the atmosphere of the game. 
Please note the following specifications for the trial version:
・Single play only 
・Save data cannot be transferred to the final version 
・Simplification of some settings and options
These limitations are only for the trial version, and the full version will have all the features listed on our Steam page. We ask for the understanding and cooperation of all players. 

We also welcome your feedback on the Steam Community Hub and Discord. We would appreciate it if you could send us your opinions and impressions of the trial version!
Stay tuned for adventures in the wonderful world of Never Grave. 

Never Grave Development Team
